command: vg deconstruct (HPRC v1.1 chr22) -> chr22.graph.vcf ; python3 benchmark/pangenome/derive_junctions.py chr22.graph.vcf jx.tsv 50 ; adjudicate --pangenome-junctions jx.tsv --pangenome-provenance population (specificity on real FLAIR) ; python3 benchmark/pangenome/gate1_check.py $PIG benchmark/pangenome/testdata/sample_junctions.tsv (sensitivity + firewall)
data_provenance: HPRC v1.1 Minigraph-Cactus GRCh38 graph -> vg deconstruct (chr22) -> derive_junctions.py (population deletions >=50bp -> 1520 graph junctions). Adjudicated sample is OUT of the graph's 47 assembly samples (HG002/NA24385 absent -> non-circular).
notes: GATE-1: the file-based pangenome reference-bias rescue, validated on the REAL HPRC v1.1 chr22 graph. Specificity = 0 false rescues on real FLAIR novel junctions; sensitivity = rescue fires when a novel intron is a real population deletion (population provenance); circularity firewall holds every rescue AMBIGUOUS under circular-risk provenance; near-miss/control never rescued. Current 0.0.3 binary reproduces gate1_check on the committed junction sample (integration_pangenome_gate1).
